title: A Prime Agent's governance path switches from Sky-wide voting to its own token holders once its Root Edit Primitive is operational
content:
A.1.10.2.3.2.2.3 defines the Prime Spell Process as a four-week pipeline and accommodates two governance paths keyed to a single technical fact. The **Sky Governance path** "applies to Prime Agents whose Root Edit Primitive is not yet operational; in this state, Prime Spell content is ratified through the Sky Core Atlas Edit Proposal process." The **Independent Governance path** "applies to Prime Agents whose Root Edit Primitive is operational; in this state, Prime Spell content is ratified through the voting process defined in the Prime Agent's Root Edit Primitive."

The divergences are confined to the ratification steps and are enumerated rather than left implicit. Under Sky Governance, Core GovOps drafts an Atlas Edit Proposal, the Core Facilitator publishes a Governance Poll, Aligned Delegates vote, and the result is incorporated into the Atlas (A.1.10.2.3.2.2.3.2.4, A.1.10.2.3.2.2.3.3.2, A.1.10.2.3.2.2.3.3.5). Under Independent Governance, the Operational Facilitator prepares an Agent Artifact Edit Proposal, the Prime's own token holders vote, and the result is incorporated into the Prime's Artifact. Even the risk assessor changes: the Core Council Risk Advisor versus "an independent risk assessor designated by the Prime Agent" (A.1.10.2.3.2.2.3.2.3).

This is graduated sovereignty implemented without forking the process. The mechanics — forum publication, technical scope, review, payload delivery, Executive Sheet recording — are identical on both paths; only the source of legitimacy moves. That keeps a single operational pipeline for Sky Core to integrate against no matter how many Primes have graduated, and makes independence a switch rather than a migration.

Note what independence does *not* buy: the Prime Spell still lands in a Sky Core Spell via the shared Executive Process. Primes gain autonomy over *what* they propose, not over *how* it executes.
description: Same four-week pipeline, different ratifier: Aligned Delegates approve an Atlas Edit Proposal until the Prime can run its own vote, after which content is codified into the Prime's own Artifact.
